description: This file contains unit tests for the SQLite template in a project scaffolding system. It tests template initialization info retrieval, project setup, database creation, configuration loading, and template variable replacement. It also verifies SQLite-specific behaviors and executable script outputs.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for test outputs, cleaning up after.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory with configuration and Python script files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a sample ProjectConfig object with predefined parameters for testing.

methods.name: test_sqlite_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Validates that the template provides correct initialization information.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the project directory creation and content population using the template.

methods.name: test_database_creation(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Runs the generated init script to create a SQLite database and verifies its structure and data.

methods.name: test_default_database_name(template_dir, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that the system generates or infers a reasonable default database name when not explicitly provided.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures that post-processing scripts are executed and have the desired effect.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Verifies that project configuration can be correctly loaded from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests that template placeholders are replaced correctly in generated files.

methods.name: test_sqlite_specific_features(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Checks SQLite-specific features, confirming certain parameters are handled appropriately.

methods.name: test_entry_point_url(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures the entry point URL incorporates the correct database name information.
